parameters.jsCode:
// 干净的客户数据表实际存在的正式字段
const allowedFields = [
  "company_name",
  "business_type",
  "phone",
  "website",
  "address",
  "state",
  "country",
  "email",
  "email_status",
  "rating",
  "industry_match",
  "phone_clean",
  "phone_type",
  "whatsapp_available",
  "email_valid",
  "lead_score",
  "lead_level",
  "lead_status",
  "source",
  "notes",
  "reject_reason",
  "is_duplicate",
  "processed_at",

  "crm_status",
  "next_action",
  "next_action_at",
  "last_contact_channel",
  "last_contact_at",

  "email_outreach_status",
  "email_sent_at",
  "email_followup_count",

  "whatsapp_outreach_status",
  "whatsapp_message",
  "whatsapp_sent_at",
  "whatsapp_followup_count",

  "reply_status",
  "reply_channel",
  "replied_at",
  "conversation_notes",

  "email_message_id",
  "email_thread_id",
  "email_last_reply_content",
  "email_last_reply_at",

  "email_intent",
  "email_intent_score",
  "email_ai_summary",
  "email_ai_reply_draft",
  "email_draft_status",

  "email_is_duplicate",
  "phone_is_duplicate"
];

// 创建一个全新的干净对象
const cleanJson = {};

// 只保留目标数据表真实存在的字段
for (const field of allowedFields) {
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call($json, field)) {
    cleanJson[field] = $json[field];
  }
}

return cleanJson;
